Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::depositFunds(quantity: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		inputCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.Password = PasswordValidated and
		o.CardID = InputCard.CardID),
		depositedNumber: Real = quantity,
		bool: Boolean = (Quantity>=100)
	precondition:
		inputCard.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		PasswordValidated = true and
		CardIDValidated = true and
		Quantity>=100
	postcondition:
		let inputCard: BankCard in
		inputCard.Balance = inputCard.Balance+depositedNumber and
		result = true
}
